identification: Large brick-built LEGO minifigure, about 47cm. Photo shows a blocky, stud-faced head, red torso and arms, blue overalls, and chunky yellow claw-like hands made of stacked bricks. The shapes are angular and the hands are crude, which looks like a home or hobbyist build rather than the official rounded 19 inch LEGO store display figure (which is a factory-moulded sort of build with a smooth head). No LEGO label, base or instructions visible.

viewing_check: Look for LEGO branding, stamped or printed LEGO logos on studs, a base plate, or any label or serial; check whether the head and torso are moulded official pieces or ordinary stacked bricks, whether it has a hidden frame or glue, and how stable it is. Official 19 inch store displays have a smooth moulded look and a base; this one looks home built, so assume low value unless it proves official.
